notes:
JARVIS v0.5.12

本次更新令自動排程在 Mac 重新啟動、睡眠及關閉 JARVIS 後更可靠。Mac 睡眠期間，JARVIS 不會執行任何工作；喚醒後才會補跑。另外新增「用量」頁，簡化首次設定及 Google 日曆連接，並修正確認框、日曆頁同步及 Bedrock、Claude、Gemini 的多項問題。

新增
- 快速設定：首次開啟 JARVIS 時，按三個步驟完成設定：選擇 AI、連接 Google 日曆、試問日程。如想先設定電郵，可按「改為設定電郵」。
- 連接 Google 前，JARVIS 會先列出 Google 頁面上要做的步驟，包括「進階」→「前往 JARVIS」及剔選日曆權限。如在 Google 頁面沒有剔選日曆，JARVIS 會提示你，按「允許日曆」可重新開啟授權頁。
- 在瀏覽器完成 Google 登入後，頁面會以中英文說明已完成，JARVIS 亦會自動回到前景。
- 回報問題：視窗底部的狀態列新增「回報問題」，會在你的郵件 App 開啟一封已填上 JARVIS 版本的電郵，由你檢查後自行寄出。
- 登入時開啟：JARVIS 現在會在你登入 Mac 時自動開啟，Mac 重新啟動後排程可以繼續執行。JARVIS 放在「應用程式」資料夾後，此功能才會自動啟用。可在「設定」>「背景運作」關閉；關閉後不會再自動開啟。「刪除此 Mac 上的所有 JARVIS 資料」亦會關閉此功能。
- 每日簡報：可在「設定」>「背景運作」開啟，並選擇時間（預設為 08:30）。到達時間時，JARVIS 會顯示通知，並在工作總覽顯示當日會議、工作及未讀郵件；網絡可用時會補上 AI 摘要。只有準時執行、Mac 未進入睡眠而且螢幕未鎖定時才會朗讀；如當時 Mac 正在睡眠或 JARVIS 未開啟，簡報會在同日稍後顯示一次，不會朗讀；當日過後便不會顯示。
- 接駁電源時保持喚醒（預設關閉）：開啟後，Mac 使用電源期間不會因閒置而自動進入睡眠。合上螢幕後此選項無效。
- 自動排程頁新增「立即執行」；執行紀錄會標明該次是準時執行、事後補跑還是手動執行。
- 用量：「設定」>「用量」顯示此 Mac 記錄的 AI 用量。可選最近 30 日、90 日、6 個月、1 年或 2 年，並按模型、供應商、功能或時間分組，顯示請求次數、輸入、輸出及快取 token、費用、本機模型佔比及費用最高的請求；Gemini 語音轉文字及 MiniMax 語音合成的用量亦會記錄，MiniMax 語音按字元顯示。每次請求的記錄保留 30 日，之後合併為每日總數，保留兩年；每日總數不含提示或郵件內容。所有用量只存於此 Mac，日子按 UTC 計算。
- Bedrock 模型：「設定」>「模型」的「供應商優先次序」中，Bedrock 一列設有清單，可按名稱選擇模型。已儲存 AWS 憑證時，每次開啟該部分，JARVIS 都會向 AWS 查詢已儲存地區內由 AWS 定義的推論設定檔，以及可按需使用的文字模型；AWS 密鑰須獲准 bedrock:ListInferenceProfiles 及 bedrock:ListFoundationModels。如帳戶未獲某個模型的存取權限，即使該模型在清單中，AWS 仍可能拒絕。未儲存憑證、未能連接 AWS 或 AWS 不允許查詢時，清單改為簡短的內置清單，並說明原因。「預設」使用預設模型；「其他（輸入 ID）」可輸入 Bedrock 主控台的模型 ID 或推論設定檔 ID。JARVIS 會使用這裏儲存的模型，不再按請求類型改用其他模型；用量按實際發送的模型 ID 記錄。「+ Bedrock Claude」按鈕改稱「+ Bedrock」。電郵工作區「分析設定」中以自備 AWS Bedrock 帳戶進行的群組分析，以及設定導引中「電郵改用公司 AWS Bedrock 帳戶」的選項，亦設有相同的清單，每次顯示清單時同樣會向 AWS 查詢；這兩處必須選擇模型（沒有「預設」），並以該處本身的按鈕儲存。以自備 AWS Bedrock 帳戶進行的電郵分析，以及設定導引對此的測試，現在與對話一樣發送模型 ID：us.、eu. 或 apac. 開頭的設定檔會按已儲存 AWS 憑證的地區發送；以往因設定檔屬於其他地區而遭 AWS 拒絕的設定，現在會按你的地區發送，如獲 AWS 接受，費用由該 AWS 帳戶支付。
- 電郵分析（使用你選擇的 AI 時）及 AI 整理現在可使用 Bedrock，不再顯示「暫不支援這項功能」。這兩項功能的 Bedrock 錯誤訊息會按介面語言以中文或英文顯示；已儲存的 AWS 憑證無法讀取時，JARVIS 會請你在設定中重新儲存。使用 Claude 時，AI 整理改為要求 Claude 以固定格式回覆。

修正
- 「中斷連接」、「切換帳戶」、「移除密鑰」及中斷其他 Google 帳戶時，確認框沒有出現，按下後沒有反應。現在改用 JARVIS 內的確認框。
- AI 使用工具後的回覆，句子會黏在一起（例如「calendar.Tomorrow」）。現在新的一段會另起一段。
- AI 新增、更改或取消活動後，日曆頁會即時更新，不再等到下次同步。
- 回覆完成後，狀態列不再一直顯示「Composing response…」。朗讀回覆期間會顯示正在朗讀，按 Esc 可停止。
- Google 登入的等候時間由 3 分鐘延長至 10 分鐘，足夠 Google 要求你在手機確認；仍可按「取消」提早結束。等候結束時會說明登入未完成，不再顯示「OAuth cancelled」。
- 「連接」頁的「在設定頁管理」會直接開啟「助手 Google」（AI 供應商一欄則開啟「模型」），不再開啟上次顯示的設定頁。
- 批准卡片以活動名稱及 Mac 時區的開始時間顯示活動，不再顯示 Google 的原始時間字串。
- Mac 睡眠或 JARVIS 關閉期間錯過的排程，在喚醒或重新開啟後只會補跑最近一次；較早的不會逐一補跑，同一次排程亦不會執行兩次。
- 喚醒後網絡尚未恢復時，需要網絡的排程（電郵、日曆、Notion 及 GitHub 同步）會等候網絡恢復後才執行，不再因此顯示「排程執行失敗」。
- JARVIS 在排程執行期間被強制結束時，重新開啟後會將該次排程重新執行一次。
- Mac 在排程執行期間進入睡眠時，該次執行不再視為失敗；喚醒後 JARVIS 會重新執行。
- 更改時區或夏令時間轉換後，排程會按新的本地時間執行，無須重新開啟 JARVIS。
- Mac 長時間睡眠後，JARVIS 會先更新已過期的 Google 存取權杖，再進行同步。
- 會議提示因 Mac 睡眠而錯過時，如會議尚未結束，JARVIS 會提示一次「會議進行中」。
- Bedrock 的用量按 AWS 就每次請求回報的輸入、輸出、快取讀取及快取寫入 token 記錄；AWS 已計費但沒有內容的回覆亦會記錄用量。
- Gemini 沒有回覆任何內容時，對話會說明是 Gemini 沒有回覆，並建議改用其他模型；如之前已完成部分操作，會註明這些操作已保留，不會重複執行。
- Gemini 的回覆長度上限改為所選模型本身的上限，以前一律為 4,096 token；JARVIS 不知道上限的模型仍為 4,096 token。傳送給 Gemini 的工具說明會先移除 Gemini 不支援的格式。

變更
- 「啟動時朗讀晨早簡報」已由每日簡報取代。曾開啟該選項的用戶，每日簡報會自動開啟（08:30）。
- 價格表未收錄的模型不再按每百萬 token US$3／US$15 估算費用。用量頁及 AI 整理會顯示「價格未知」，該用量不計入任何金額，亦不當作免費。
- 「設定」>「儲存空間」的清理不再刪除 AI 用量記錄。
- 更新後首次開啟時，JARVIS 會一次過更正此 Mac 上較早的用量記錄。較早版本為使用了快取的 Bedrock 請求計算的費用偏低：2026 年 10 月 29 日之前的記錄會更正，費用可能比之前高；其後的部分記錄無法與正確的記錄區分，會保持原樣。以前按估算價格或 US$0 記錄、而價格表仍未收錄的雲端模型用量，改為「價格未知」。本機模型的用量一律為 US$0。超過 30 日的請求會合併為每日總數。
notes_en:
JARVIS v0.5.12

This update makes automations dependable across restarts, sleep and quitting JARVIS. Nothing runs while your Mac is asleep; JARVIS catches up after it wakes. It also adds a Usage page, makes first-run setup and connecting Google Calendar simpler, and fixes confirmation dialogs, Calendar page updates and several problems with Bedrock, Claude and Gemini.

New
- Quick setup: the first time you open JARVIS, three steps set it up: choose your AI, connect Google Calendar, and ask about your day. To set up mail first, choose Set up Mail instead.
- Before you connect Google, JARVIS lists what to do on Google's pages, including Advanced > Go to JARVIS and ticking the calendar permission. If the calendar box was not ticked, JARVIS says so, and Allow Calendar opens Google's page again.
- When you finish signing in to Google in the browser, the page says so in English and Chinese, and JARVIS comes back to the front.
- Report a problem: the status bar at the bottom of the window has Report a problem. It opens an email to the team in your mail app with the JARVIS version filled in; you check it and send it yourself.
- Open at login: JARVIS now opens when you log in to your Mac, so automations keep running after a restart. It turns on by itself once JARVIS is in your Applications folder. Turn it off in Settings > Background; once you turn it off, it stays off. "Delete all JARVIS data on this Mac" turns it off as well.
- Daily briefing: turn it on in Settings > Background and choose a time (08:30 unless you change it). JARVIS shows a notification and a briefing on the Automation page with today's meetings, tasks and unread mail, and adds an AI summary when the network is available. It is read aloud only when it runs on time, with the Mac awake and the screen unlocked. If the Mac was asleep or JARVIS was closed at that time, the briefing is shown once later the same day and is not read aloud. Once that day is over it is not shown.
- Keep awake on mains power (off unless you turn it on): while it is plugged in, the Mac does not go to sleep on its own. It does not help with the lid closed.
- The Automations page has a Run now button, and the run history says whether a run was on time, caught up afterwards or started by hand.
- Usage: Settings > Usage shows the AI usage recorded on this Mac. Choose the last 30 days, 90 days, 6 months, 1 year or 2 years, and group it by model, provider, feature or time. It shows requests, input, output and cache tokens, cost, the local model share and the most expensive requests. Gemini speech to text and MiniMax text to speech are recorded too, MiniMax speech in characters. Each request is kept for 30 days, then as daily totals for two years; the daily totals hold no prompts or mail. All of it stays on this Mac. Days are counted in UTC.
- Bedrock model: in Settings > Models, under Provider priority, the Bedrock row has a list for picking the model by name. When AWS credentials are saved, JARVIS asks AWS each time you open that section for the inference profiles AWS defines and the text models that can be called on demand in your saved region; for this, the AWS key needs bedrock:ListInferenceProfiles and bedrock:ListFoundationModels. AWS can still refuse a listed model if your account has no access to it. Without saved credentials, or when AWS cannot be reached or does not allow the request, the list is a short built-in one and the picker says why. "Default" runs the default model, and "Other (enter an ID)" takes a model ID or an inference profile ID from the Bedrock console. JARVIS uses the model saved there and no longer switches to another model depending on the kind of request. Usage is recorded under the ID actually sent. The "+ Bedrock Claude" button is now "+ Bedrock". The Mail page's Analysis settings, for group analysis with your own AWS Bedrock account, and the setup guide's option to use a company AWS Bedrock account for mail have the same list, and JARVIS asks AWS for it in the same way each time the list is shown there; there you must choose a model, as there is no "Default", and the form's own button saves it. Mail analysis with your own AWS Bedrock account, and the setup guide's test of it, now send the model ID as chat does: a us., eu. or apac. profile is sent for the region of your saved AWS credentials, so a setup that AWS refused because its profile was for another region is now sent for your region, and if AWS accepts it the request is charged to that AWS account.
- Mail analysis with the AI you chose, and AI sorting, can now use Bedrock instead of saying the feature is not supported. In these two features Bedrock's error messages follow the interface language, English or Chinese, and when the saved AWS credentials cannot be read JARVIS asks you to save them again in Settings. With Claude, AI sorting now asks Claude for a fixed-format answer.

Fixed
- Disconnect, Switch account, Remove key and disconnecting another Google account did nothing, because the confirmation never appeared. They now ask in JARVIS's own dialog.
- In replies where the AI used a tool, sentences ran together (for example "calendar.Tomorrow"). Each part now starts a new paragraph.
- After the AI adds, moves or cancels an event, the Calendar page updates straight away instead of at the next sync.
- The status bar no longer keeps saying "Composing response..." after a reply is finished. While a reply is read aloud it says so, and Esc stops it.
- Google sign-in now waits up to 10 minutes instead of 3, long enough for Google to ask you to confirm on your phone; Cancel still ends it early. If the time runs out, the message says the sign-in did not finish instead of "OAuth cancelled".
- Manage in Settings on the Connections page opens Assistant Google (Models for AI providers) instead of whichever settings section was shown last.
- The approval card names an event by its title and its start time in your Mac's time zone, instead of Google's raw time.
- Automations missed while the Mac was asleep or JARVIS was closed: after waking or reopening, only the latest missed run is caught up. Earlier ones are not run one by one, and the same scheduled run never runs twice.
- When the network is not back yet after waking, automations that need it (mail, calendar, Notion and GitHub sync) wait for it instead of failing, so "Scheduled jobs failed" no longer appears for that reason.
- If JARVIS is force-quit in the middle of a run, that run is done once more when JARVIS reopens.
- If the Mac goes to sleep in the middle of a run, the run is no longer counted as failed; JARVIS does it again after the Mac wakes.
- After a time zone change or a daylight saving change, automations follow the new local time without reopening JARVIS.
- After a long sleep, JARVIS refreshes an expired Google access token before syncing instead of using the old one.
- If the Mac was asleep when a meeting reminder was due and the meeting is still going on, JARVIS shows one "Meeting in progress" notice.
- Bedrock usage is recorded as AWS reports it for each request: input, output, cache read and cache write tokens. A reply AWS charged for but that has no content is recorded as well.
- When Gemini returns an empty answer, the chat says that it was Gemini and suggests another model. If some actions were already completed, it says they were kept and will not be repeated.
- Gemini replies can be as long as the chosen model allows, where JARVIS knows that model's limit; before, every Gemini reply was capped at 4,096 tokens. Tool descriptions sent to Gemini have the parts Gemini does not support removed first.
- The clean-up report in English uses singular and plural correctly.

Changed
- "Speak morning briefing on startup" is replaced by the daily briefing. If you had it on, the daily briefing is turned on for you at 08:30.
- Models that are not on the price list are no longer priced at a guessed US$3 / US$15 per million tokens. The Usage page and AI sorting show "Price unknown" instead; that usage is in none of the amounts and is not counted as free.
- Clean-up in Settings > Storage no longer deletes AI usage records.
- The first time JARVIS opens after the update, it corrects older usage records on this Mac once. Earlier versions worked out too low a cost for Bedrock requests that used the cache: records from before 29 October 2026 are corrected, so their cost may be higher than before; some later ones cannot be told apart from correct records and stay as they were. Usage of cloud models that are still not on the price list, recorded at the guessed price or at US$0, now reads "Price unknown". Local models always read US$0. Requests older than 30 days are combined into daily totals.
